name: Barbarian Technology Totem Warrior
body:
Barbarians who revere technology are either descendants of lost civilizations, or were exposed to the achievements of more refined countries. In either case, they consider technology as magic or divine power- even if some of them can come to understand it better for what it is and exploit it for fighting.

Totem Rage Powers

A technology totem warrior must take the following rage powers: lesser technology totem at 2nd level, technology totem at 6th level, and greater technology totem at 10th level.

Tinker (Ex)

At 1st level, the barbarian gains Technologist as a bonus feat.

This replaces fast movement.

Disabler (Ex)

At 3rd level, the barbarian gains the trapfinding ability as a rogue of the same level, but it only applies to technological traps or devices.

This replaces trap sense.

Mechanical Fury (Su)

At 6th level, the barbarian can draw power from a technological device in his possession to fuel her rage. She regains 1 additional round of rage for every 2 charges consumed from the device. She can regain a number of rounds of rage per day equal to ½ her barbarian level with this ability.

Cyber-Warrior (Ex)

Beginning at 7th level, the barbarian’s limit of implantation points increases by 1, +1 for every 3 levels beyond 7th she possesses. She uses her Charisma score, in place of her Intelligence score, to determine her total number of implantation points, and can allocate her bonus points between her Charisma and Constitution scores as she chooses.

This replaces damage reduction.

Rage Powers

The following rage powers complement the technology totem warrior archetype: gearbreaker and smasher.
